title.narrative: Strengthened capacity of member States to ratify and apply international labour standards and to fulfil their reporting obligations

description.narrative: The objective of the CPO DJI826 is to support the Government of Djibouti to consider ratification of migration related conventions as well as C. 189 on domestic work and C. 190 on violence and harassment at work. The strategy employed in this regard is to leverage on the ongoing projects that include the Better Regional migration Management Project (BRMM) and Joint Labour Migration Programme (JLMP) as well the phase II of the EU funded Free Movement of Persons and Transhumance (FMPT), which have maintained a solid dialogue on ILS in the country. However, given the reporting and implementation deficits, Djibouti should concentrate on revising its current record of recommendations, and make use of recommendations made by the SRM/TWG, because Djibouti ratified a number of conventions which are either outdated or up for abrogation. Research on migration aspects, as well as domestic work, are envisaged in Djibouti for the biennium. Thanks to the project’s efforts, Djibouti committed to the ratification of C. 181 on private employment agencies. The instrument of ratification is expected to be submitted in 2024. Djibouti also agreed to look into the possible ratification of convention No. 160 on statistics, for which the ILO is prepared to provide the required support.
